name: smwpatches-slow-message-box-v1
title: Slow Message Box v1.1
description:
Makes message boxes show the message frame by frame instead of all at once. You may skip the wait (makes it load instantly) by pressing START or SELECT by default.

Includes SFX and SFX generation script by Lui37.

Note that by its nature, it is incompatible with most custom message systems, even vanilla-like ones like Sprite Message Box or Inline Layer 3 Messages.

Changelog:
v1.0: Initial release
v1.1: Remoderation update, testing python script with Python 3.9.6 and 3.11.2, fixing Yoshi House and switch messages.
